answers.core: This is about providing security-related functionality, which is important to use in the context of multiplayer games. The engine also already provides several `String.strip_*` and `String.*_escape` methods for formats such as JSON and XML.
answers.workaround: Yes, as documented on the [BBCode in RichTextLabel](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/tutorials/ui/bbcode_in_richtextlabel.html) page.
